verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an agent library, but the evidence pack documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for smolagents. The only related item is OpenTelemetry instrumentation of agent runs, which is an observability feature, not a control for disabling vendor usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
